data_fields.name: landmarks_per_zone_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 (code comment only, dgn-overview.cc:605; not enforced in the list code)

best_idea: A per-zone services-seen-so-far list: record a service the first time its cell is seen, move the record when its feature moves, forget it when the service is destroyed, and list the seen ones grouped by zone with a key that jumps to the nearest one.
decision_why: Frankendom has no town hub yet, but the same registry gives the zone minimap and a services list that fills in as the player walks, with no pre-revealed town; use one typed map with a kind field and fix the donor defects listed in the note.
acceptance: A player who walks into a zone sees a Services list that holds only the inns and smiths they have already seen; when a smith is destroyed it leaves the list and the minimap at once, and the jump key walks to the nearest one still listed.
